header: The US dollar in rupees over the last year: the chart under the currency converter, shown only while the converter is on USD and INR (either way round: it is the same relation). I drew it like the gold and fuel charts: dates along the bottom, the highest and the lowest day marked with their date, and four figures under it (the rate a year ago, the highest, the lowest and the latest). The data come from /api/live/usd-inr (src/lib/live/usdInr.ts): the European Central Bank's reference rate of each working day, the same table as the converter's own rate. Nothing typed is sent anywhere.

symbols.name: inr
doc: Written as ₹94.04, or ₹90 for a round figure (the axis shows round values)

behaviours: the first point is the very date a year back (13 Nov 2025 when today is 13 Nov 2026) and, a working day, carries no note
when the date a year back is a Saturday (15 Nov 2025) the chart still begins on it and says that the ECB published no rate that day, so the rate of Friday 14 Nov is shown
the rupee formatting: 94.04 keeps its paise, a round axis value does not
the points are labelled with their days
the range chip says what the numbers are: rupees for one dollar, each working day, 13 Nov 2025 to 12 Nov 2026
the rate a year ago: Start · 1 year ago, ₹88.69 on 13 Nov 2025
the highest in between: ₹96.83 on 20 May 2026, and the latest is below it
the lowest in between: ₹88.50 on 19 Nov 2025
the latest rate: ₹94.04 on 12 Nov 2026, with the number of working days
the callouts on the line name the high and the low with their days
the line is a sloping line (a rate moves every day), not a staircase
no sentence about 'held from' (that is for prices that stay until changed)
the note says whose rates, working days only, that the last point is the converter's rate, and that banks and the RBI differ
the pair is USD and INR, in either order, and no other
USD to INR: the chart's card is under the converter
INR to USD: the same chart
USD to EUR, GBP to INR, and a length conversion: no chart
the card says it is fetching, and nothing typed is in its request: a fixed route in the hook call
